real_locus.smoothness_proof: The complex cone has no nonzero critical point. On f=0 intersectS4, a vanishing tangential gradient would give grad f=c*x; Euler givesc=0, contradicting cone smoothness.
real_locus.no_fixed_locus_intersections: Two distinct reflections multiply to a nonidentity D power, free on Y. Thus their fixed loci are disjoint.
real_locus.associative_reason: K sends eta and transverse omega to their negatives and the complex3-form to its conjugate. The fixed real3-locus is special Legendrian, hence associative for the invariant weakG2 form.
real_locus.not_computed: Topology/connected components of R, calibrated volumes, charged localized spectra, resolutions and their backreaction.

spin.supersymmetry_scope: Projects the known SU4-invariant spinor pair to one. Published Spin7 quotient construction supplies the standardN1 AdS route; no full interacting localized spectrum or accidental spinors computed.

Wilson_tradeoff.reason: K D K=D^-1 would require W and W^-1 to be conjugate. Their eigenvalue multisets differ, so the previous3+2 Wilson line does not extend.
Wilson_tradeoff.larger_110_underlying_pi1: C5, which still cannot split standardSU5 by an ordinary Wilson line
Wilson_tradeoff.parity_scope: diag(1,1,1,-1,-1) is a valid conditionalSU5 isotropy projection. It is not a flat Wilson line on the underlying space and does not supply anSU5 gauge sector.
Wilson_tradeoff.C_field_scope: Neither363 nor15 smooth flat-C counts is inherited without a new orbifold/differential calculation. Isotropy and2-primary data matter.

holomorphic_gauge_control.projective_involution_fixed_locus: smooth plane cubic E plus a projective line
holomorphic_gauge_control.link_fixed_locus: Q, the circle bundle over E with Euler degree3
holomorphic_gauge_control.volume_reason: Base Kahler class(pi/2)H gives area(E)=3pi/2; Reeb periodpi gives volume3pi^2/2. Full quotient divides by the effective involution centralizer of order6.
holomorphic_gauge_control.exclusion_proof: Every noninvolution has ambient fixed dimension<=1, hence no fixed link vector by invariant-cubic smoothness and Euler. A higher finiteSU2 subgroup has an element of order>2. Thus only genericA1 codimension4 singularities occur in this holomorphic quotient.
holomorphic_gauge_control.V4_intersections: Three circle directions perV4 fixed binary cubic; local cone C x (C^3/V4), codimension6 on the link, not anA2 codimension4 locus.
holomorphic_gauge_control.tree_gauge_kinetic_coefficient: g4^-2=R^3 Vol(Q_unit)/g7^2, with Vol(Q_unit)=3pi^2/2 for the singleC2 quotient, pi^2/4 for the fullPSL generic-stratum orbifold volume.
holomorphic_gauge_control.physics_scope: Standard localADE gauge-action reduction, conditional on the unfrozen local theory. The normalized7D gauge coupling, thresholds, flux interactions and singular-intersection matter are not calculated. These formulas are not observed coupling predictions.

physics: Standard unfrozen A1 local model supports an su2 gauge algebra along each singular real3-component. Full orbifold quantum consistency, gauge multiplicities, colorSU3 and chiralSM are not supplied.
